items.title: Yassine double gives Strasbourg 2-1 Ligue 1 win over Lens
items.author: Philip O'connor
items.creator: Philip O'connor
items.summary: Winger Gessime Yassine struck twice as Strasbourg came from behind to beat Lens 2-1 at home on Saturday, ending the visitors' strong start to the season after they wilted in a disjointed second-half display.
items.body:
Winger Gessime Yassine struck twice as Strasbourg came from behind to beat Lens 2-1 at home on Saturday, ending the visitors' strong start to the season after they wilted in a disjointed second-half display.
Winners of the French Cup and runners-up in the league last term, Lens followed up their 1-0 Trophee des Champions win over Paris St Germain with a 5-2 mauling of Auxerre in their first league game, with Florian Thauvin getting the winner against PSG and netting twice in their opener.
Lens took the lead when Jeyland Mitchell felled Abdallah Sima in the box, and captain Thauvin stepped up to confidently rattle home the spot kick in the 38th minute.
Strasbourg were not behind for long, coming out all guns blazing in the second half and equalising through a Yassine strike after three minutes, with a deflection wrong-footing Robin Risser in the Lens goal.
Strasbourg had a 56th-minute goal ruled out for offside after a VAR review but they were not to be denied, and they grabbed a well-deserved winner in the 85th minute when Sebastian Nanasi crossed for Yassine to volley his second of the game to secure the three points.
On Friday, PSG [USN:L6N44P13T TEXT:"scored twice in stoppage time"] to salvage a 2-2 draw away to Lille.

items.title: Bessent diz que oscilações desordenadas do iene podem desestabilizar mercados globais
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: O secretário do Tesouro dos EUA, Scott Bessent, afirmou que oscilações desordenadas do iene poderiam desencadear “liquidações forçadas” de posições, o que corre o risco de desestabilizar os mercados globais e, em última instância, elevar os custos de financiamento para famílias e empresas norte-americanas.
items.body:
O secretário do Tesouro dos EUA, Scott Bessent, afirmou que oscilações desordenadas do iene poderiam desencadear “liquidações forçadas” de posições, o que corre o risco de desestabilizar os mercados globais e, em última instância, elevar os custos de financiamento para famílias e empresas norte-americanas.
Bessent fez esses comentários em uma carta datada de 27 de agosto e publicada em sua conta no X um dia depois, em resposta à exigência da senadora democrata Elizabeth Warren por uma explicação sobre a intervenção cambial conjunta de Washington e Tóquio no mês passado.
A publicação ocorre no momento em que o iene voltou a se desvalorizar em relação ao dólar, apesar das expectativas de que o Banco do Japão pudesse elevar as taxas de juros no curto prazo.
O Japão e os Estados Unidos realizaram uma rara intervenção conjunta de compra de ienes em 31 de julho, sinalizando sua determinação em impedir que uma onda de vendas do iene e dos títulos do governo japonês se espalhasse para os mercados globais.
Embora o iene tenha se recuperado de uma mínima em 40 anos, próxima a 164 por dólar, atingida no mês passado, ele voltou a enfraquecer em direção a 160 após subir para 155,20 logo após a intervenção.
A moeda caiu brevemente abaixo do nível de 160 por dólar na sexta-feira — um limiar amplamente visto como aumentando a probabilidade de intervenção —, depois que comentários do chair do Federal Reserve, Kevin Warsh, reacenderam as expectativas de um aumento das taxas de juros nos EUA no curto prazo.
Na carta, Bessent afirmou que o Tesouro conduziu a intervenção trocando ativos em moeda estrangeira mantidos em seu Fundo de Estabilização Cambial (ESF) por ienes.
“O mesmo princípio foi aplicado na Argentina, onde o Tesouro utilizou o Fundo de Estabilização Cambial para estabilizar o país em um momento de grave iliquidez de curto prazo e para impedir que o problema se transformasse em uma crise regional mais ampla”, disse ele.
“A crise mais bem administrada é aquela que nunca acontece”, disse Bessent, defendendo a decisão de Washington de se unir aos esforços de Tóquio para conter quedas desordenadas do iene.
O ESF é uma reserva de emergência administrada pelo Tesouro dos EUA para estabilizar os mercados cambiais e financeiros domésticos.
O Tesouro utilizou o ESF no ano passado para ajudar a sustentar o mercado do peso argentino e fornecer uma linha de swap cambial de US$20 bilhões com o objetivo de estabilizar a moeda.

items.title: Nouvelle attaque de colons israliéens contre des maisons en Cisjordanie-Témoins
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Plusieurs dizaines de colons militants israéliens masqués ont attaqué des maisons autour du village de Qusura, en Cisjordanie occupée, premier assaut d'ampleur depuis le siège de la zone par des colons plus tôt dans le mois, qui avait suscité un tollé international.
items.body:
Plusieurs dizaines de colons militants israéliens masqués ont attaqué des maisons autour du village de Qusura, en Cisjordanie occupée, premier assaut d'ampleur depuis le siège de la zone par des colons plus tôt dans le mois, qui avait suscité un tollé international.
Les colons ont encerclé une maison palestinienne où sept personnes étaient retranchées, et lancé des pierres, ont dit des témoins à Reuters.
Selon Saddam Oday, une des personnes à l'intérieur, l'armée israélienne a tiré des gaz lacrymogènes dans la maison et placé les habitants en détention, tout en le laissant partir. Selon lui, l'armée n'a appréhendé aucun des colons et les a laissé libres de s'en aller.
Le propriétaire de la maison, Luay Bayruti, a déclaré que lorsque les militaires sont arrivés, ils ont passé les menottes aux personnes à l'intérieur, bandé leurs yeux et les ont frappé, avant de les relâcher.
Dans un communiqué, l'armée israélienne a dit que les soldats et la police des frontières étaient arrivés sur place pour faire partir des "émeutiers" et protéger les résidents à l'intérieur de la maison. Elle n'a pas répondu immédiatement aux demandes de commentaire sur les raisons qui ont poussé les forces de l'ordre à tirer des gaz lacrymogènes sur la maison, et à détenir et frapper ses habitants.
Pour sa première déclaration publique sur Qusra, le Premier ministre israélien Benjamin Netanyahu a condamné les violence sur place et les a imputées à "une poignée d'émeutiers".
"Je condamne fortement les actes criminels de violence commis dans les villages de Qusra et Jalud", a-t-il ajouté, faisant référence à un autre incident survenu dans un village voisin.
Les Etats-Unis ont déjà fait pression sur le Premier ministre israélien pour qu'il condamnent les colons militants qui ont a assiégé des Palestiniens à leur domicile, ont dit à Reuters des responsables américains et israéliens deux semaines plus tôt.
Le gouvernement d'Israël a précédemment imputé les violences de colons à une "infime minorité", une description mise à mal par le constat que font les associations de défense des droits.
Une enquête des Nations unies a fait état en juin d'une implication directe des autorités israéliennes dans les attaques de colons où des Palestiniens ont trouvé la mort, été blessés ou contraints à l'exode en Cisjordanie occupée.
La mission israélienne a Genève conteste les conclusions de l'enquête.
Selon des organisations de défense des droits, la présence accrue de colons dans la périphérie de villages palestiniens, comme Qusra, s'inscrit dans un plan plus large des colons israéliens visant à gagner du terrain sur une terre où les Palestiniens envisagent d'établir un Etat.
Les instances des Nations unies et la plupart des pays du monde jugent les implantations des colons illégales aux yeux du droit international sur l'occupation militaire. Israël rejette ces accusations, arguant qu'à ses yeux la région est contestée, et non pas occupée.
La Cisjordanie, territoire conquis par Israël lors de la Guerre des Six-Jours en 1967, abrite environ trois millions de Palestiniens et 500.000 colons. Elle compte quelque 146 colonies ainsi que 390 avant-postes plus petits, selon Peace Now, une organisation israélienne de surveillance des colonies.

items.title: Roundup: NFL teams begin roster cuts before Sunday deadline
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: The Buffalo Bills are releasing punter Mitch Wishnowsky and wide receiver/kick returner Mecole Hardman Jr., ESPN reported Saturday.
items.body:
The Buffalo Bills are releasing punter Mitch Wishnowsky and wide receiver/kick returner Mecole Hardman Jr., ESPN reported Saturday.
Rookie Tommy Doman Jr., a seventh-round draft pick out of Florida, won the punter job in training camp.
Wishnowsky spent six seasons with the San Francisco 49ers before his one season with Buffalo in 2025. He averaged 45.3 yards on 38 punts in 13 games.
Hardman won three Super Bowls with the Kansas City Chiefs, who selected him in the second round of the 2019 NFL Draft. He appeared in just two games for the Bills last season and returned two punts for 4 total yards and gained 61 yards on his one kickoff return.
The deadline for teams to reduce their roster to the 53-player maximum is 6 p.m. ET on Sunday.
--The Miami Dolphins announced a dozen players were waived: cornerback Alex Austin; running backs Coleman Bennett and Donovan Edwards; tackle Kevin Cline; edge Seth Coleman-Lyles; tight end Ethan Conner, inside linebackers Stephen Dix Jr. and Jaheim Thomas; defensive linemen Alex Huntley and Cam Rice; safety Louis Moore; wide receiver Theo Wease Jr.
--The Tampa Bay Buccaneers are waiving quarterback Connor Bazelak, who spent part of last season with the team, NBC Sports reported. Also being waived are running back Barika Kpeenu, tight end Kenny Fletcher, guard Nash Hutmacher, defensive tackle Travis Shaw and linebacker John Bullock.
Veteran QB Jake Browning is on the Tampa Bay roster to back up starter Baker Mayfield.
--Field Level Media

items.title: OpenAI vai interromper fornecimento de modelos de IA para Cursor, da SpaceX, intensificando disputa com Musk
items.author: Anusha Devang Shah, Shubham Kalia
items.creator: Anusha Devang Shah, Shubham Kalia
items.summary: A OpenAI anunciou na sexta-feira que planeja interromper o fornecimento de modelos de IA à Cursor, empresa de ferramentas de programação que agora pertence à SpaceX, de Elon Musk, o que marca mais um agravamento na acirrada rivalidade entre o presidente-executivo da OpenAI, Sam Altman, e Musk.
items.body:
A OpenAI anunciou na sexta-feira que planeja interromper o fornecimento de modelos de IA à Cursor, empresa de ferramentas de programação que agora pertence à SpaceX, de Elon Musk, o que marca mais um agravamento na acirrada rivalidade entre o presidente-executivo da OpenAI, Sam Altman, e Musk.
Musk e Altman estão em desacordo há anos, uma disputa que culminou no início deste ano em um julgamento sobre a ação judicial de US$ 150 bilhões movida por Musk contra a OpenAI. Durante o julgamento, o advogado de Musk afirmou que Musk e outras testemunhas haviam declarado que Altman era um mentiroso, enquanto a OpenAI argumentou que Musk havia buscado o controle da empresa.
“Estamos tomando essa decisão porque não podemos ter certeza de que a SpaceX utilizará nossa tecnologia de acordo com nossos termos de serviço, com base em nossa experiência com as empresas de Elon Musk que violaram contratos”, afirmou a OpenAI em uma postagem no blog.
Musk respondeu na madrugada deste sábado em uma postagem no X, escrevendo: “Não poderia me importar menos.”
Ele acusou Altman e o presidente da OpenAI, Greg Brockman, de serem “indignos de confiança”, ao mesmo tempo em que repetiu sua alegação de que eles “roubaram uma organização sem fins lucrativos de código aberto”.
Musk, a pessoa mais rica do mundo, havia processado a OpenAI e Altman acusando-os de trair a missão original sem fins lucrativos da empresa para benefício próprio. Um júri federal decidiu contra Musk no início deste ano, concluindo que ele havia entrado com a ação tarde demais.
No entanto, Michael Truell, cofundador da Cursor e atualmente executivo da SpaceX, disse no X que a empresa estava conversando com a equipe da OpenAI para resolver essa questão.
Horas após o anúncio da OpenAI, a Anthropic — que rivaliza com ambas as empresas, mas mantém uma parceria em andamento com a SpaceX —, afirmou que planejava aumentar a capacidade computacional para dar suporte aos modelos Claude na Cursor, segundo Tom Brown, um dos cofundadores da empresa.
Em sua postagem no blog, a OpenAI afirmou que o X, anteriormente conhecido como Twitter e agora parte da SpaceX, havia violado os termos de seu contrato com a OpenAI após Musk ter adquirido a plataforma.
“Para trabalhar com um grande parceiro como a SpaceX, normalmente contamos com contratos personalizados para garantir o cumprimento de nossos termos de serviço e que a integração ofereça segurança em grande escala”, acrescentou a empresa de IA.
A criadora do ChatGPT disse que propôs a data de encerramento de 12 de novembro de 2026, acrescentando que seu acordo com a Cursor lhe concedia um prazo limitado para rescindir o contrato após “uma mudança de controle”.
A SpaceX (SPCX.O) anunciou em junho um acordo para comprar a Anysphere, a startup por trás da Cursor, por US$60 bilhões em uma transação totalmente em ações, e concluiu a aquisição no início deste mês.

items.title: Bessent dice que fluctuaciones descontroladas del yen pueden desestabilizar los mercados mundiales
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: El secretario del Tesoro de Estados Unidos, Scott Bessent, dijo que las fluctuaciones desordenadas del yen podrían desencadenar "liquidaciones forzadas" de posiciones que podrían desestabilizar los mercados mundiales y, en última instancia, elevar los costos de financiación para los hogares y las empresas estadounidenses.
items.body:
El secretario del Tesoro de Estados Unidos, Scott Bessent, dijo que las fluctuaciones desordenadas del yen podrían desencadenar "liquidaciones forzadas" de posiciones que podrían desestabilizar los mercados mundiales y, en última instancia, elevar los costos de financiación para los hogares y las empresas estadounidenses.
Bessent hizo estas declaraciones en una carta fechada el 27 de agosto y publicada en su cuenta de la red social X un día después, en respuesta a la petición de la senadora demócrata Elizabeth Warren de que se diera una explicación sobre la intervención monetaria conjunta de Washington y Tokio del mes pasado.
La publicación se hizo en un momento en que el yen vuelve a debilitarse frente al dólar, pese a las expectativas de que el Banco de Japón pueda subir las tasas de interés a corto plazo.
Japón y Estados Unidos llevaron a cabo una inusual intervención conjunta de compra de yenes el 31 de julio, lo que puso de manifiesto su determinación de evitar que la venta masiva de yenes y de bonos del Estado japonés se extendiera a los mercados mundiales.
Aunque el yen se ha recuperado del mínimo de 40 años, cercano a las 164 unidades por dólar, tocado el mes pasado, ha vuelto a debilitarse y ronda las 160 tras repuntar a 155,2 poco después de la intervención.
La divisa cayó brevemente por debajo las 160 el viernes, un umbral que suele considerarse que aumenta la probabilidad de una intervención, tras comentarios del presidente de la Reserva Federal, Kevin Warsh, que reavivaron las expectativas de un alza de tasas en Estados Unidos a corto plazo.
En la carta, Bessent afirmó que el Tesoro llevó a cabo la intervención intercambiando activos en divisas extranjeras mantenidos en su Fondo de Estabilización Cambiaria (ESF) por yenes.
"El mismo principio se aplicó en Argentina, donde el Tesoro utilizó el Fondo de Estabilización Cambiaria para estabilizar el país en un momento de grave falta de liquidez a corto plazo y para evitar que el problema se convirtiera en una crisis regional más amplia", afirmó.
"La crisis mejor gestionada es aquella que nunca se produce", afirmó Bessent, defendiendo la decisión de Washington de sumarse a los esfuerzos de Tokio para contrarrestar las caídas desordenadas del yen.
El ESF es una reserva de emergencia gestionada por el Tesoro estadounidense para estabilizar los mercados de divisas y los mercados financieros nacionales.
El Tesoro recurrió al ESF el año pasado para ayudar a respaldar el mercado del peso argentino y proporcionar una línea de swap de divisas de 20.000 millones de dólares destinada a estabilizar la moneda.

items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: The Baltimore Ravens are trading defensive tackle C.J. Okoye to the New York Giants in exchange for a 2028 seventh-round draft pick, NFL Network reported on Saturday.
items.body:
The Baltimore Ravens are trading defensive tackle C.J. Okoye to the New York Giants in exchange for a 2028 seventh-round draft pick, NFL Network reported on Saturday.
The deal reunites the former NFL International Player Pathway participant with New York coach John Harbaugh, whom Okoye played for in Baltimore last season.
Okoye, 24, played in 13 games (no starts) with the Ravens in 2025, accumulating 15 tackles, one quarterback hit and one pass defensed in his first NFL campaign.
The 6-foot-6, 370-pound Okoye hails from Nigeria. He joined the Los Angeles Chargers through the IPPP in 2023 and spent two seasons on their practice squad.
--Field Level Media

items.title: OpenAI dejará de suministrar modelos de IA a Cursor, propiedad de SpaceX, agravando disputa con Musk
items.author: Anusha Devang Shah, Shubham Kalia
items.creator: Anusha Devang Shah, Shubham Kalia
items.summary: OpenAI anunció el viernes que tiene previsto dejar de suministrar modelos de inteligencia artificial a Cursor, una empresa de herramientas de programación propiedad de SpaceX, de Elon Musk, lo que supone una nueva escalada en su encarnizada rivalidad entre el presidente ejecutivo de OpenAI, Sam Altman.
items.body:
OpenAI anunció el viernes que tiene previsto dejar de suministrar modelos de inteligencia artificial a Cursor, una empresa de herramientas de programación propiedad de SpaceX, de Elon Musk, lo que supone una nueva escalada en su encarnizada rivalidad entre el presidente ejecutivo de OpenAI, Sam Altman.
Musk y Altman llevan años enfrentados, una disputa que culminó a este año en un juicio por la demanda de 150.000 millones de dólares presentada por Musk contra OpenAI. Durante el juicio, el abogado de Musk afirmó que tanto él como otros testigos habían declarado que Altman era un mentiroso, mientras que OpenAI argumentó que Musk intentó hacerse con el control de la empresa.
"Tomamos esta decisión porque no podemos confiar en que SpaceX utilice nuestra tecnología respetando nuestras condiciones de servicio, dada nuestra experiencia con las empresas de Elon Musk, que han incumplido contratos", declaró OpenAI en una entrada de blog.
Musk respondió el sábado por la mañana en una publicación en la red social X, en la que escribió: "Me da completamente igual".
Acusó a Altman y al presidente de OpenAI, Greg Brockman, de ser "poco fiables", al tiempo que reiteró su afirmación de que "robaron una organización sin ánimo de lucro de código abierto".
Musk, la persona más rica del mundo, había demandado a OpenAI y a Altman por "robar una organización benéfica", al traicionar la misión original sin ánimo de lucro de la empresa para su propio enriquecimiento. Un jurado federal falló en contra de Musk, al considerar que había presentado la demanda demasiado tarde.
Sin embargo, Michael Truell, cofundador de Cursor y actualmente ejecutivo de SpaceX, afirmó en X que la empresa estaba en conversaciones con el equipo de OpenAI para resolver este asunto.
Horas después del anuncio de OpenAI, Anthropic —que compite con ambas empresas, pero mantiene una colaboración con SpaceX— afirmó que tenía previsto aumentar la capacidad de cálculo para dar soporte a los modelos de Claude en Cursor, según Tom Brown, uno de los cofundadores de la empresa.

items.title: Bessent says disorderly yen moves can destabilize global markets
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said disorderly moves in the yen could trigger "forced unwinds" of positions that risk destabilizing global markets and ultimately raising borrowing costs for U.S. households and businesses.
items.body:
U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said disorderly moves in the yen could trigger "forced unwinds" of positions that risk destabilizing global markets and ultimately raising borrowing costs for U.S. households and businesses.
Bessent made the comments in a letter dated August 27 and posted on his X account a day later in response to Democratic Senator Elizabeth Warren's demand for an explanation of Washington's joint currency intervention with Tokyo last month.
The post came as the yen resumed weakening against the dollar despite expectations the Bank of Japan could raise interest rates in the near term.
Japan and the United States carried out a rare joint [USN:L1N43Z05E TEXT:"yen-buying intervention"] on July 31, signaling their determination to prevent a selloff in the yen and Japanese government bonds from spilling over into global markets.
While the yen has recovered from a 40-year low near 164 per dollar hit last month, it has weakened back towards 160 after surging to 155.20 shortly after the intervention.
The currency briefly slipped below the 160-per-dollar level on Friday, a threshold widely seen as increasing the likelihood of intervention, after comments from Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh revived expectations of a near-term U.S. rate hike.
In the letter, Bessent said the Treasury conducted the intervention by exchanging foreign-currency assets held in its [USN:FWN44P1TN TEXT:"Exchange Stabilization Fund"] (ESF) for yen.
"The same principle was at work in Argentina, where Treasury used the Exchange Stabilization Fund to stabilize Argentina in a moment of acute, short-term illiquidity and to prevent the problem from becoming a broader regional crisis," he said.
"The best-managed crisis is the one that never happens," Bessent said, defending Washington's decision to join Tokyo's efforts to counter disorderly declines in the yen.
The ESF is an emergency reserve managed by the U.S. Treasury to stabilize foreign-exchange and domestic financial markets.
The Treasury used the ESF last year to help support [USN:L1N43X0RQ TEXT:"Argentina"]'s peso market and provide a $20 billion currency swap line aimed at stabilizing the currency.

items.title: Argentina lift Women’s Hockey World Cup title to break Dutch dominance
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Argentina were crowned Women’s Hockey World Cup winners on Saturday after defeating hosts and favourites the Netherlands 3-1 in a shootout following a 1-1 draw in the final.
items.body:
Argentina were crowned Women’s Hockey World Cup winners on Saturday after defeating hosts and favourites the Netherlands 3-1 in a shootout following a 1-1 draw in the final.
The Dutch were seeking a fourth successive World Cup title and took the lead through tournament top-scorer Yibbi Jansen on 30 minutes, her eighth of the World Cup.
But Argentina levelled on 54 minutes via Maria Granatto to send the game to penalties.
It is Argentina’s third World Cup title, and first since 2010, and some revenge for losing in the final to the Dutch four years ago.
Earlier, Belgium claimed their first bronze medal since 1978 when they defeated Australia 1-0 in the third-place playoff. Charlotte Englebert scored the only goal of the game.

items.title: Colonos israelíes perpetran nuevo ataque contra viviendas en Qusra, Cisjordania
items.author: Pesha Magid
items.creator: Pesha Magid
items.summary: Decenas de colonos israelíes enmascarados atacaron el sábado viviendas situadas cerca de la localidad ocupada de Qusra, en Cisjordania, en lo que supone el primer ataque de envergadura desde que el asedio a la zona provocara una oleada de indignación internacional más temprano en el mes.
items.body:
Decenas de colonos israelíes enmascarados atacaron el sábado viviendas situadas cerca de la localidad ocupada de Qusra, en Cisjordania, en lo que supone el primer ataque de envergadura desde que el asedio a la zona provocara una oleada de indignación internacional más temprano en el mes.
Los colonos rodearon una vivienda palestina y lanzaron piedras mientras siete personas quedaban atrapados en su interior, según testigos que hablaron con Reuters.
Saddam Oday, uno de los atrapados, afirmó que el ejército israelí lanzó gas lacrimógeno al interior de la vivienda y detuvo a los residentes que se encontraban dentro, mientras que a él lo dejaron marchar. Afirmó que los militares no detuvieron a ninguno de los colonos y les permitieron marcharse.
El propietario de la vivienda, Luay Bayruti, dijo que, cuando llegó el ejército, esposaron, vendaron los ojos y golpearon a las personas que se encontraban en el interior, antes de liberarlas más tarde.
El ejército israelí afirmó en un comunicado que las tropas y las fuerzas de la policía de fronteras habían acudido al lugar para desalojar a los "alborotadores" y proteger a los residentes que se encontraban dentro de la vivienda.
El ejército no respondió de inmediato a una solicitud de comentarios sobre por qué, según se informó, habían disparado gas lacrimógeno contra la vivienda y habían detenido y golpeado a los residentes.
Bayruti afirmó que, tras llamar al ejército israelí para pedir ayuda, él y otras seis personas quedaron atrapados dentro de la vivienda durante más de una hora mientras los colonos les lanzaban piedras. Bayruti mostró a un reportero de Reuters un brazo vendado, que, según dijo, había resultado herido por una piedra durante el ataque.
Oday, un médico, afirmó que cuatro de los atrapados sufrieron lesiones a causa del gas lacrimógeno y otros dos por las piedras lanzadas por los colonos.
El ataque ocurrió a unos cientos de metros de distancia de tres viviendas que los colonos sitiaron este mes, lo que provocó la condena internacional y un despliegue militar israelí masivo que, según los residentes, los ha mantenido prácticamente atrapados en sus casas.
"Vieron a los residentes trabajando en su casa, que aún está en construcción, y empezaron a lanzar piedras", explicó Loui Ridi, un palestino-estadounidense cuya vivienda fue una de las tres asediadas este mes. Afirmó que presenció el ataque del sábado desde su casa.
Ridi señaló que había presenciado incursiones casi diarias de colonos israelíes en los alrededores de su casa, a pesar de la fuerte presencia militar israelí en la zona.
Las organizaciones de derechos humanos afirman que la creciente presencia de colonos en las afueras de pueblos palestinos como Qusra forma parte de un esfuerzo más amplio para arrebatar más tierras a los palestinos, mermando aún más el territorio en el que pretenden establecer un Estado.
La violencia de los colonos judíos en la Cisjordania ocupada ha ido en aumento, y algunos se han envalentonado gracias al Gobierno del primer ministro Benjamin Netanyahu, que ha supervisado una expansión masiva de los asentamientos en el territorio. Netanyahu no ha hecho comentarios sobre la situación en Qusra.
El ejército israelí afirmó en su comunicado que, junto con la policía fronteriza, seguirá "operando en las zonas de Qusra y (la vecina) Jalud para evitar nuevos disturbios y restablecer el orden en la zona".
Los organismos de la ONU y la mayoría de los países consideran que los asentamientos son ilegales según el derecho internacional relativo a las ocupaciones militares. Israel rechaza esta postura y considera que la zona es objeto de disputa, en lugar de estar ocupada.

items.title: Larry Christenson, 1980 World Series champ, dies at 72
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Larry Christenson, a pitcher who won the World Series with the Philadelphia Phillies in 1980, died unexpectedly on Friday at age 72, the team announced.
items.body:
Larry Christenson, a pitcher who won the World Series with the Philadelphia Phillies in 1980, died unexpectedly on Friday at age 72, the team announced.
The Phillies' statement did not reveal a cause of death, but the team said Christenson was on a fishing trip with family and friends in his native Washington state at the time of his passing.
"The club and its fans are forever grateful for his contributions and the legacy he leaves behind in Philadelphia," the team said. "We extend our heartfelt condolences to Larry's beloved daughters, Claire and Libby, his extended family and friends, and former teammates at this difficult time."
The Phillies drafted Christenson in the first round (third overall) in 1972 out of Marysville High School in Washington. He made his MLB debut on April 13, 1973, at age 19, giving up one run on five hits and six walks in a complete game, 7-1 win against the New York Mets.
No other Phillies pitcher threw a complete game in his debut until Carlton Loewer did so 25 years later on June 14, 1998.
It was the only game Christenson won all season, finishing his first year with a 1-4 record and 6.55 ERA. That finish didn't sour the Phillies on the right-hander, who spent all 11 seasons of his career in Philadelphia.
He appeared in 243 games (220 starts) from 1973-83, compiling a career record of 83-71 with a 3.79 ERA in the regular season.
He also was a decent hitter for a pitcher. On Sept. 27, 1977, he was the winning pitcher in a 15-9 game against the Chicago Cubs and also hit a grand slam and drove in five runs. For his career, he hit 11 homers, drove in 46 runs and had a .150 batting average.
Christenson played in four postseason series with the Phillies and was 1-2 with a 7.40 ERA.
The Phillies beat the Kansas City Royals in six games to win the 1980 World Series. He was part of the 1983 team that won the National League pennant and lost to the Baltimore Orioles in the World Series but did not pitch in the playofs. He missed much of the season due to elbow surgery and was not included on the postseason roster.
His Phillies teammates remembered him fondly on Friday.
"Larry was very special, the guy that kept in touch with all of us," former teammate Mike Schmidt said in a statement. "He always had a smile on his face, he never forgot a moment he spent with you. His passing will leave a hole in all of our hearts. May he rest in peace."
--Field Level Media

items.title: Nepal retoma operações de resgate das vítimas das enchentes, busca ajuda técnica e bilhões de dólares
items.author: Gopal Sharma, Saurabh Sharma, Sahana Bajracharya, Liz Lee
items.creator: Gopal Sharma, Saurabh Sharma, Sahana Bajracharya, Liz Lee
items.summary: O Nepal retomou as operações de busca e resgate neste sábado, após uma breve suspensão devido às condições climáticas, enquanto as autoridades procuravam por quase 3.000 pessoas desaparecidas após uma enchente devastadora que matou centenas de pessoas e assolou uma região na fronteira com o Tibete.
items.body:
O Nepal retomou as operações de busca e resgate neste sábado, após uma breve suspensão devido às condições climáticas, enquanto as autoridades procuravam por quase 3.000 pessoas desaparecidas após uma enchente devastadora que matou centenas de pessoas e assolou uma região na fronteira com o Tibete.
O empobrecido país himalaio, com 30 milhões de habitantes, solicitou assistência especializada do exterior, e seu ministro da Fazenda disse à Reuters que também precisaria de cerca de US$4 bilhões a US$5 bilhões para a reconstrução após o desastre.
Provocada pelo colapso de uma geleira, uma torrente de rochas, gelo, lama e detritos desceu rapidamente pelos sistemas fluviais das montanhas na quarta-feira, matando pelo menos 669 pessoas no Nepal e sete no Tibete chinês, além de arrasar prédios, pontes e usinas de energia.
Quase 3.000 pessoas continuam desaparecidas, incluindo 2.426 no Nepal e 554 no condado de Gyirong, no Tibete, entre elas pelo menos 540 estrangeiros, muitos dos quais peregrinos hindus da Índia.
CORPOS EM DECOMPOSIÇÃO E IRRECONHECÍVEIS SERÃO ENTERRADOS As operações de busca e resgate foram temporariamente suspensas devido à chuva e ao nevoeiro, mas retomadas no final da tarde (horário local), informou um policial do distrito de Rasuwa, uma das regiões mais atingidas.
“Os helicópteros estão voando e a operação foi retomada após uma melhora nas condições climáticas”, disse ele, sob condição de anonimato, pois não está autorizado a falar com a mídia.
As autoridades também haviam suspendido os trabalhos de resgate na sexta-feira, quando um lago, formado na fronteira entre o Nepal e a China após a enchente, começou a transbordar para os rios Lhende Khola e Trishuli, no Nepal.
Até sábado, o risco havia diminuído e partes do leito do lago estavam visíveis, informaram as autoridades chinesas e a emissora estatal CCTV. Imagens de satélite sugeriram que a água estava escoando lentamente do lago, reduzindo gradualmente seu tamanho, informou a CCTV.
O lago é um dos dois a montante da zona de enchentes que estão sendo monitorados pelo Nepal. Os riscos de enchentes persistirão até que ambos tenham esvaziado completamente, alertou uma autoridade.
Três dias após o desastre, as autoridades informaram que alguns corpos recuperados estavam em estado de decomposição avançada, impossibilitando a identificação. Eles serão enterrados após o cumprimento das formalidades legais devido aos riscos à saúde e ao temor de surtos de doenças.
“Amostras de DNA serão coletadas, e os corpos serão enterrados em um espaço aberto”, informou a administração do distrito de Chitwan em um comunicado.
FAMÍLIAS PROCURAM OS DESAPARECIDOS Em Katmandu, familiares das pessoas desaparecidas se reuniram em frente ao Campus Médico de Maharajgunj, para onde alguns corpos haviam sido levados. Muitos tentaram identificar parentes a partir de fotografias dos corpos exibidas nos portões e muros.
Na Malásia, familiares de 91 cidadãos listados como “inacessíveis” no Tibete e no Nepal também aguardavam notícias.
Manivannan Rethinam, representante de alguns deles, instou o Ministério das Relações Exteriores a estabelecer um canal de comunicação para atualizações mais rápidas, dizendo que a falta de informações era “profundamente dolorosa” para os familiares que aguardavam notícias.
O Ministério das Relações Exteriores da Malásia informou que os esforços de busca e resgate, bem como de verificação, continuavam.
Para os sobreviventes, o calvário está longe de terminar, já que eles enfrentam a tarefa de reconstruir suas vidas.
Saraswati Ghale, de 43 anos, disse que sua casa foi destruída pela enchente. Ela se lembrou de ter subido a colina às pressas quando a água chegou, sacudindo o chão “como se fosse um terremoto”.
“Não tenho mais nada... Estou salva, mas quem sabe como as coisas vão se desenrolar”, disse ela.
O ministro das Finanças do Nepal, Swarnim Wagle, disse à Reuters que a estimativa inicial do governo era de que a reconstrução custaria entre US$ 4 bilhões e US$ 5 bilhões.
“Isso é apenas uma estimativa. As perdas e os danos estão sendo avaliados”, disse ele.
AJUDA TÉCNICA O ministro das Relações Exteriores do Nepal, Shisir Khanal, disse que o país não precisava de ajuda nas operações de busca e resgate, mas necessitava de assistência especializada para resgatar pessoas presas em túneis, restaurar as linhas de transporte e comunicação onde as pontes foram destruídas, identificar corpos, realizar testes de DNA e armazenar corpos por períodos mais longos.
“Já solicitamos esses serviços especializados e assistência técnica em áreas nas quais não temos expertise e conhecimento técnico suficientes”, disse ele à Reuters na noite de sexta-feira.
Uma equipe de especialistas indianos em túneis chegou ao Nepal neste sábado, disse ele, enquanto a agência de notícias chinesa Xinhua informou que Pequim havia enviado cinco especialistas em túneis para apoiar os esforços de resgate, com mais quatro prestes a se juntar a eles.
A Índia já enviou três voos transportando 60 toneladas de suprimentos de emergência, incluindo cobertores, medicamentos e alimentos.
O país também ofereceu equipes de resposta a desastres, pontes pré-fabricadas e equipes técnicas para ajudar a restaurar a conectividade, informou o Ministério das Relações Exteriores.
As autoridades chinesas também correm contra o tempo para localizar mais de 500 pessoas que continuam desaparecidas após a enchente.
As equipes de resgate chegaram na sexta-feira ao complexo da passagem de fronteira de Gyirong, o local mais atingido, usando cordas para atravessar florestas e penhascos depois que as estradas que levavam ao local foram destruídas.
Imagens de vigilância da passagem de fronteira mostraram torrentes de água e detritos engolindo edifícios quando a enchente atingiu a região, enquanto as pessoas tentavam fugir.
items.raw_description: O Nepal retomou as operações de busca e resgate neste sábado, após uma breve suspensão devido às condições climáticas, enquanto as autoridades procuravam por quase 3.000 pessoas desaparecidas após uma enchente devastadora que matou centenas de pessoas e assolou uma região na fronteira com o Tibete.

items.title: Pogacar abandona por caída la Vuelta a España cuando marchaba líder
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: El líder de la Vuelta a España, Tadej Pogacar, abandonó la carrera el sábado tras sufrir una caída durante la octava etapa que le dejó al cinco veces ganador del Tour de Francia con la cara ensangrentada y una lesión en el hombro.
items.body:
El líder de la Vuelta a España, Tadej Pogacar, abandonó la carrera el sábado tras sufrir una caída durante la octava etapa que le dejó al cinco veces ganador del Tour de Francia con la cara ensangrentada y una lesión en el hombro.
El ciclista esloveno, que llevaba el maillot rojo de líder desde que ganó la primera etapa, sufrió una caída en el pelotón cuando quedaban poco más de 30 kilómetros para el final de la etapa entre Pucol y Xeraco.
Pogacar, de 27 años, intentó volver a subirse a la bicicleta tras recibir atención médica, pero no pudo reanudar la carrera y acabó caminando hasta una ambulancia.
"Lamentablemente, Tadej Pogacar se ha visto obligado a abandonar la Vuelta tras una caída en la octava etapa", publicó su equipo, el UAE Team Emirates-XRG, en la red social X, confirmando el abandono de su corredor.
Pogacar, que ganó su quinto Tour el mes pasado y se había adjudicado el Giro de Italia en 2024, aspiraba a su primera victoria general en la Vuelta para convertirse en el noveno ciclista en ganar las tres grandes vueltas europeas.
Comenzó la etapa con una ventaja de tres minutos y 50 segundos sobre el segundo clasificado, Enric Mas.
Bryan Coquard (Cofidis) ganó la etapa tras otra caída masiva en el último kilómetro. Mads Pedersen terminó segundo, mientras que Jordi Meeus fue tercero.
Mas (Movistar) se hizo con el maillot rojo, convirtiéndose en el primer español en liderar la carrera desde Jesús Herrada en 2018. Félix Gall es segundo en la general, a un minuto y 11 segundos del nuevo líder.

items.title: Israeli settlers stage new attack on home in West Bank's Qusra, witnesses say
items.author: Pesha Magid
items.creator: Pesha Magid
items.summary: Dozens of masked Israeli settler militants attacked homes surrounding the occupied West Bank village of Qusra on Saturday, the first major attack since a siege by settlers in the area earlier this month drew an international outcry.
items.body:
Dozens of masked Israeli settler militants attacked homes surrounding the occupied West Bank village of Qusra on Saturday, the first major attack since a [USN:L1N44A0G5 TEXT:"siege by settlers"] in the area earlier this month drew an international outcry.
The settlers surrounded a Palestinian home, throwing stones while seven Palestinians were trapped inside, according to witnesses who spoke to Reuters.
Saddam Oday, one of those trapped, said the Israeli military fired tear gas into the home and detained the residents inside while letting him go. He said the Israeli military had not detained any of the settlers and had allowed them to leave.
The owner of the house, Luay Bayruti, said when the military arrived they handcuffed, blindfolded and beat those inside, before later releasing them.
The Israeli military said in a statement that troops and border police forces had arrived on the scene to remove "rioters" and protect the residents inside the house.
The military did not immediately respond to a request for comment on why they had reportedly fired tear gas at the house and detained and beaten the residents.
In his first public statement on Qusra, Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said he condemned the violence in Qusra and blamed a "handful of rioters".
"I strongly condemn the criminal acts of violence committed in the villages of Qusra and Jalud," said Netanyahu, referring to a separate incident in a neighbouring village.
The United States had previously pressured Netanyahu to publicly condemn the militant settlers who had besieged Palestinians in their homes, U.S. and Israeli officials [USN:L6N44B0L9 TEXT:"told"] Reuters around two weeks ago.
The Israeli government has previously [USN:L8N3X215E TEXT:"blamed"] a "fringe minority" for settler violence, a characterisation disputed by findings from rights groups.
A U.N. inquiry in June [USN:L6N42H0E8 TEXT:"found"] that Israeli authorities are directly involved in settler attacks that have killed, injured and displaced Palestinians in the occupied West Bank. The Israeli mission in Geneva rejected the report's findings.
RESIDENT REPORTS NEAR-DAILY ENCROACHMENTS Bayruti said that after calling the Israeli military for help, he and six others were trapped inside the home for more than an hour as settlers threw stones.
Bayruti showed a Reuters reporter his bandaged arm, which he said had been injured by a stone during the attack.
Oday, a medic, said four of those trapped had suffered injuries due to the tear gas, and two had suffered injuries from the stones thrown by settlers.
The attack occurred a few hundred yards away from three homes to which settlers laid siege this month, drawing [USN:L6N44B0NM TEXT:"international condemnation"] and a massive Israeli military deployment that residents say has kept them effectively trapped in their homes.
"They spotted the residents working on their house, which is still under construction and they started throwing rocks," said [USN:L8N44E16L TEXT:"Loui Ridi"], a Palestinian-American whose home was one of the three under siege this month. He said he watched Saturday's attack occur from his home.
Ridi said he had seen near-daily encroachments of Israeli settlers into the area surrounding his home, despite the heavy Israeli military presence in the area.
SETTLER VIOLENCE ON THE RISE Rights groups say the increasing settler presence on the edge of Palestinian villages, like Qusra, is part of a wider effort by settlers to seize more land from Palestinians, further eating into territory where Palestinians aim to establish a state.
Violence by Jewish settlers in the occupied West Bank has increased, with some emboldened by the government of Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, who has overseen a massive settlement expansion in the territory.
U.N. bodies and most countries deem the settlements illegal under international law regarding military occupations. Israel rejects this, viewing the area as disputed rather than occupied.
items.raw_description: Dozens of masked Israeli settler militants attacked homes surrounding the occupied West Bank village of Qusra on Saturday, the first major attack since a siege by settlers in the area earlier this month drew an international outcry.

items.title: Ataque russo a depósito de munições na região de Kiev provoca explosão e  mata 37 pessoas
items.author: Dan Peleschuk
items.creator: Dan Peleschuk
items.summary: Pelo menos 37 pessoas morreram depois que um ataque com drone russo a um depósito de munições na região de Kiev provocou uma explosão, afirmou o presidente, Volodymyr Zelenskiy, neste sábado, prometendo punir a suposta negligência no segundo incidente desse tipo em dois meses.
items.body:
Pelo menos 37 pessoas morreram depois que um ataque com drone russo a um depósito de munições na região de Kiev provocou uma explosão, afirmou o presidente, Volodymyr Zelenskiy, neste sábado, prometendo punir a suposta negligência no segundo incidente desse tipo em dois meses.
O ataque russo mais mortal na região de Kiev neste ano ocorreu enquanto os ataques aéreos de Moscou contra a capital ucraniana e a região ao redor se estendiam pelo terceiro dia consecutivo, matando moradores, danificando casas e perturbando a vida cotidiana.
Dezenas também ficaram feridas e centenas foram retiradas da área do ataque na noite de sexta-feira na vila de Myla, disse Zelenskiy, onde infraestruturas próximas, incluindo edifícios residenciais e um centro para idosos e pessoas com deficiência, sofreram “danos significativos”.
O ataque provocou incêndios generalizados, segundo autoridades. Entre os mortos estava o chefe de um vilarejo vizinho que correu para ajudar.
“Uma situação terrível e uma negligência terrível por parte daqueles que armazenaram explosivos bem ao lado das pessoas”, disse Zelenskiy em um discurso em vídeo.
SEGUNDA DETONAÇÃO RELACIONADA A ATAQUE EM DOIS MESES O local da explosão da sexta-feira era uma instalação militar que abrigava projéteis de artilharia, minas e drones, entre outras munições, acrescentou ele.
O incidente seguiu-se a um caso semelhante na cidade de Vyshneve, na região de Kiev, no mês passado, quando 10 pessoas morreram e centenas de casas foram danificadas após um ataque ter provocado explosões secundárias.
“Outro crime desse tipo – depois do que aconteceu em Vyshneve – é absolutamente inaceitável”, disse Zelenskiy. “Espero que os detalhes sejam apresentados ao público imediatamente.”
Ele acrescentou que já foram abertos processos criminais sob a acusação de negligência oficial. Autoridades ucranianas raramente divulgam os danos causados a alvos militares por ataques russos.
Em comunicado divulgado neste sábado, o Ministério da Defesa da Ucrânia afirmou que todos os responsáveis pelo armazenamento de armas devem realizar uma auditoria completa em suas instalações.
ENXAMES DE DRONES ASSOLAM KIEV POR DIAS Outras nove regiões foram alvo de ataques noturnos da Rússia, acrescentou Zelenskiy, dizendo que Kiev, em particular, estava sob um “ataque praticamente ininterrupto” de drones a jato.
A Rússia intensificou sua guerra aérea contra a Ucrânia com um número crescente de mísseis balísticos difíceis de detectar e novos drones de alta velocidade, contra os quais Kiev não possui defesas aéreas capazes de abatê-los.
Neste sábado, sirenes soaram durante toda a manhã e a tarde pelo terceiro dia consecutivo, enquanto a Força Aérea da Ucrânia alertava sobre novas ondas de drones se aproximando da capital.
O som das defesas aéreas ressoou pelo céu.
O governador da região de Kiev, Tymur Tkachenko, disse que uma menina de 14 anos morreu em um ataque com drones pela manhã no distrito de Boryspil. Em Kiev, uma menina de 2 anos foi morta por um drone abatido, informou o prefeito Vitali Klitschko neste sábado.
Os ataques na cidade e nos arredores, na quinta e na sexta-feira, causaram danos a prédios residenciais e instalações de armazenamento pertencentes a grandes varejistas, parte do que algumas autoridades ucranianas descreveram como uma campanha destinada a “paralisar” a cidade de vários milhões de habitantes.

items.title: New boss Iraola encouraged despite Liverpool's winless start
items.author: Lori Ewing
items.creator: Lori Ewing
items.summary: Andoni Iraola is still waiting for his first Premier League victory as Liverpool boss, but he saw enough in Saturday's 2-2 draw with Nottingham Forest to reinforce his belief that the foundations of his new-look side are beginning to take shape.
items.body:
Andoni Iraola is still waiting for his first Premier League victory as Liverpool boss, but he saw enough in Saturday's [USN:L8N44Q03D TEXT:"2-2 draw"] with Nottingham Forest to reinforce his belief that the foundations of his new-look side are beginning to take shape.
The former Bournemouth manager was hired this summer to revive a team bruised by last season's failed title defence, when Liverpool crashed from champions in 2025 to fifth place despite spending a Premier League record £446 million on new players.
His remit is to restore Liverpool to the summit of English football and reintroduce the intensity that once made Anfield one of Europe's most daunting venues.
Iraola's answer is not caution. The Spaniard wants his side to play on the front foot, attack at pace and press relentlessly, a style that should resonate with supporters who spent years watching Juergen Klopp's "heavy-metal football" before the more measured approach of Arne Slot's two-year reign.
The transition, however, remains a work in progress. Forest's opening goal from Dan Ndoye stemmed from a direct counterattack, while long periods of a sluggish first half left Iraola frustrated.
"I think we improved a lot in the second half. We were much more intense, much quicker on the ball, with more sense of urgency," he said. "But it's not enough to win the game, and I think we have to blame the first half that we had."
The improvement after the break was unmistakable. Alexander Isak levelled shortly after the hour mark, before newcomer Victor Munoz struck the late equaliser.
Six days earlier, the Spaniard had won the crucial late penalty that secured a [USN:L6N44K05N TEXT:"2–2 draw"] with Newcastle in their opener.
"I think Victor has been very good both games," Iraola said. "Everything hasn't been perfect, but he's continued trying all the time and he's gone again and again and again. I like this a lot from the wingers.
"He has always been a threat, and also defensively has helped us a lot."
SLOW STARTERS The bigger concern for Iraola is Liverpool's tendency to start slowly, a habit they have carried over from last season. While he was encouraged by the character shown to recover from a losing position for a second consecutive match, he believes the underlying issue lies in their work without the ball.
"In the first half we were being passive without the ball, leaving a lot of distance and becoming a little bit comfortable," he said. "When we improved the intensity, we won more duels and started attacking quicker and attacking better. This lack of intensity without the ball has hurt us."
There is little panic around Anfield, despite the winless start. Iraola has said the tactical shift would take time, and his insistence on playing at a higher tempo was never likely to be mastered overnight.
Reinforcements are also on the way. Liverpool have finalised an agreement to sign France winger [USN:L4N44Q01S TEXT:"Bradley Barcola"] from Paris St Germain, according to British media reports, with the 23-year-old's pace and direct running seen as an ideal fit for Iraola's high-octane system.
For now, Liverpool remain caught between promise and progress. The entertainment value is increasing, but the victories have yet to arrive.
"It's true that we've come back from two bad results where we were losing," Iraola said. "But at the end what makes the difference are the wins and three points.
"I liked what we've done in the second half, we've been able to complete the comeback, but the point leaves you frustrated."

items.title: Pogacar forced to abandon Vuelta after stage eight crash, Mas takes overall lead
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Tadej Pogacar's bid to complete cycling's Grand Tour hat-trick came to a painful end at the Vuelta a Espana on Saturday when the race leader and five-time Tour de France winner crashed out with blood on his face and an injured shoulder.
items.body:
Tadej Pogacar's bid to complete cycling's Grand Tour hat-trick came to a painful end at the Vuelta a Espana on Saturday when the race leader and [USN:L1N43S04R TEXT:"five-time Tour de France winner"] crashed out with blood on his face and an injured shoulder.
Slovenia's Pogacar, who had been wearing the red jersey since winning the first stage, went down in the peloton with more than 30 km (19 miles) left in the ride from Pucol to Xeraco.
A television replay showed the 27-year-old swerving onto his right, colliding with another rider before going down. He was also hit by other riders coming from behind, a couple of whom also fell.
He tried to stand up and get back on his bike as his teammates stopped around him, but he sat back down as medics rushed to him.
He later walked into an ambulance with his arm in a sling, with the team announcing that he was facing surgery.
“Unfortunately, Tadej suffered a heavy crash during today’s stage and was unable to continue the race," Dr. Adrian Rotunno, Medical Director, UAE Team Emirates-XRG said in a statement.
"He is stable, and following a thorough medical assessment at hospital, Tadej has been diagnosed with a concussion, displaced left clavicle fracture, a stable C7 cervical fracture, and multiple abrasions.
"Fortunately, no other major injuries and no neurological fallout. He will require clavicle surgery which will be delayed due to concussion precautions. Tadej remains under the care of our medical team and we’ll provide further updates following the surgery.”
Pogacar, who won his fifth Tour de France last month and also won the Giro d'Italia in 2024, was aiming for his first overall victory in the Vuelta. That would have made him only the ninth rider to have won all three of cycling's Grand Tours.
He began the stage with a lead of three minutes and 50 seconds over second-placed Enric Mas.
Mas (Movistar) took the red jersey after stage eight, becoming the first Spaniard to lead the Vuelta since Jesus Herrada in 2018. Pogacar's compatriot Primoz Roglic, a four-time winner of the Vuelta, now lies second, a minute behind Mas.
SUBDUED PODIUM Frenchman Bryan Coquard (Cofidis) won the stage after several riders fell in another crash in the final kilometre. Mads Pedersen finished second while Jordi Meeus was third.
On the podium, a sombre Mas accepted the red jersey but did not wear it, holding it in front of him instead.
"It’s a real shame," Mas said about Pogacar's crash.
"I hope he gets better quickly. We've still got a few races left and I hope he'll be in good shape for them."
Pogacar's teammates who had stopped for him finally crossed the finish line nearly 12 minutes after the peloton.
The race continues on Sunday with a 187.5 km mountainous ride from Villajoyosa to Alto de Aitana.

items.title: La cadena pública italiana RAI destituye a periodista veterano, desatando una tormenta política
items.author: Gavin Jones
items.creator: Gavin Jones
items.summary: Los partidos de la oposición italiana han denunciado un ataque a la libertad de prensa después de que la cadena pública RAI destituyera a un periodista veterano como presentador de su programa estrella de investigación, mientras que los aliados del Gobierno acogieron con satisfacción la medida.
items.body:
Los partidos de la oposición italiana han denunciado un ataque a la libertad de prensa después de que la cadena pública RAI destituyera a un periodista veterano como presentador de su programa estrella de investigación, mientras que los aliados del Gobierno acogieron con satisfacción la medida.
El caso ha reavivado un debate de larga data sobre la independencia de la RAI, cuya junta directiva es nombrada por el Parlamento y el Gobierno y cuya línea editorial, según los críticos, viene determinada por la coalición gobernante de turno.
La RAI anunció el viernes por la noche la destitución de Sigfrido Ranucci tras nueve años al frente de "Report", uno de los programas de actualidad más vistos e influyentes de Italia.
"Ya no presentaré 'Report', pero lideraré la batalla más importante de mi vida: la lucha por la libertad de prensa", declaró Ranucci tras conocer la decisión.
El "caso Ranucci" ha acaparado la atención de los medios italianos durante semanas, y su destitución fue la noticia principal en los principales periódicos italianos el sábado.
El caso se inició con un atentado con bomba frente a la vivienda de Ranucci en octubre, que en un primer momento suscitó mensajes de apoyo hacia él procedentes de todo el espectro político.
La primera ministra Giorgia Meloni, cuyo partido fue a menudo objeto de investigaciones por parte de "Report", condenó el "grave acto de intimidación" y el Gobierno afirmó que se reforzaría la escolta policial de Ranucci.
Sin embargo, la postura de los políticos del Gobierno cambió bruscamente cuando el empresario Valter Lavitola, colaborador de Ranucci desde hacía mucho tiempo, fue detenido este mes y, según su abogado, declaró a la fiscalía que él había ordenado el atentado.
Las autoridades hallaron pruebas de que Ranucci tuviera conocimiento previo del atentado, pero la detención de Lavitola desencadenó una avalancha de artículos en los medios progubernamentales en los que se alegaba la existencia de un complot para impulsar la popularidad de Ranucci de cara a una posible incursión en la política.
La reacción política a su destitución refleja profundas divisiones en torno a la RAI, cuya gestión, según llevan tiempo afirmando los críticos, es vulnerable a la influencia del Gobierno.
"Report" es uno de los pocos programas de investigación de la televisión italiana, donde el panorama de la radiodifusión privada está históricamente vinculado a la política de centroderecha.
Elly Schlein, líder del Partido Demócrata de centroizquierda, fue una de las varias figuras de la oposición que afirmaron que la destitución de Ranucci demostraba que debilitar "Report" había sido un objetivo de larga data del Gobierno de derechas de cara a las elecciones previstas para el próximo año.
Los aliados de Meloni adoptaron una postura diferente. El viceprimer ministro Matteo Salvini, líder del partido nacionalista La Liga, elogió la decisión, afirmando que era la "correcta" y pidiendo que se aclaren las cuestiones relacionadas con Ranucci.
El presidente del Senado, Ignazio La Russa, del partido Hermanos de Italia de Meloni, también expresó su satisfacción, tras haber criticado con frecuencia la línea editorial del programa.
La RAI no hizo referencia a las recientes polémicas, limitándose a afirmar que quería reforzar su periodismo de investigación y promover el talento joven. Ofreció a Ranucci un puesto en otros programas de información o como corresponsal en el extranjero.
Sin embargo, para aumentar la presión sobre la cadena pública, los periodistas que trabajan en "Report" emitieron un comunicado en el que calificaban la decisión de "inaceptable" y advertían de que muchos miembros de la redacción abandonarían el programa si la dirección no daba marcha atrás.

items.body:
A Europa está fazendo declarações que sugerem que considera a Rússia um “adversário e até mesmo um inimigo”, afirmou o porta-voz do Kremlin, Dmitry Peskov, neste sábado, acrescentando que Moscou não vê perspectivas de melhora nas relações entre a Rússia e a União Europeia.
Não ficou claro imediatamente a quais declarações Peskov se referia. Ele acrescentou que os atuais políticos da UE adotam uma postura de confronto em relação à Rússia, “não apenas nas palavras, mas também nos atos”.
“Eles estão mobilizando os recursos militares da Europa e direcionando-os contra nosso país, ao mesmo tempo em que participam diretamente das hostilidades contra nós”, disse Peskov.

items.title: Trump speech bets land ex-White House teleprompter operator in trouble, fined ₹1.65 crore: What CFTC found
items.author: Garvit Bhirani
items.summary: A White House teleprompter operator, Gabriel Perez, will pay over $172,000 or nearly ₹1.65 crore to settle a federal investigation into prediction-market bets linked to Trump’s speeches. He faces a $65,000 penalty and forfeit of $107,000 in profits.
items.body: A former White House teleprompter operator Gabriel Perez has agreed to pay $172,539 ( approximately ₹1,64,66,182) to settle a federal investigation into allegedly timed prediction-market bets linked to President Donald Trump’s speeches, reported Bloomberg.He will pay a $65,000 (nearly ₹6,180,518) penalty to the Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC) and forfeit more than $107,000 (nearly ₹1,01,81,724) in profits. Perez did not admit to the regulator’s allegations that he improperly used inside information to make profitable trades on the prediction-market platform Kalshi.What CFTC foundThe CFTC said in a press release that the penalty was reduced through a “substantial discount” in recognition of Perez’s cooperation with the agency’s investigation. The regulator also said Perez had agreed to a three-year ban on trading.In its cease-and-desist order, the CFTC said, “As someone working at the White House, Perez understood the information that he learned during his work was confidential and not to be shared with anyone outside of the White House.”An attorney representing Perez was not immediately available for comment, as per the report.According to the CFTC, Perez allegedly placed the trades between December 2025 and February 2026, with most of his wagers focused on sports and Trump-related events. His bets included questions such as “What will Trump say during his remarks at the Detroit Economic Club?”The CFTC said Perez typically had access to Trump’s speeches roughly an hour before they were delivered.Kalshi detected what it considered unusual trading activity in March and reported it to the CFTC, Bloomberg reported in July. At the time, a White House spokesperson stated the employee had been placed on unpaid administrative leave but did not identify the person. The CFTC considers prediction-market platforms to be derivatives exchanges that fall under its regulatory authority.Kalshi’s head of enforcement, Robert DeNault, said in a post on X on Friday night that the company had detected trading activity that violated its rules. DeNault said the platform would hold traders accountable regardless of their status, warning that anyone who breaches its rules or federal law would face consequences.The case has added to growing concerns over the potential for prediction markets to create new avenues for insider trading.US lawmakers have introduced legislation seeking to restrict certain types of prediction-market wagers, while the White House has cautioned its employees against using confidential information to make trades on such platforms.Kalshi and PolymarketPrediction markets such as Kalshi and Polymarket have reportedly gained significant popularity over the past 18 months, offering users the ability to wager on outcomes ranging from sporting events to elections. Among these are so-called mention markets, which Perez traded in and allow users to bet on whether prominent individuals will say specific words or phrases during speeches, earnings calls or post-game media interactions.Both Kalshi and Polymarket have stated that they do not support insider trading and said they monitor their platforms for suspicious activity, reporting potential violations to law enforcement agencies and federal regulators.
items.raw_description: A White House teleprompter operator, Gabriel Perez, will pay over $172,000 or nearly ₹1.65 crore to settle a federal investigation into prediction-market bets linked to Trump’s speeches. He faces a $65,000 penalty and forfeit of $107,000 in profits.

items.title: Brevis leads South Africa to victory over Zimbabwe in T20 Tri-Series
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Dewald Brevis smashed an unbeaten 75 from 32 balls as South Africa defeated Zimbabwe by seven wickets in the second match of the Tri-Series also involving hosts Namibia in Windhoek on Saturday.
items.body:
Dewald Brevis smashed an unbeaten 75 from 32 balls as South Africa defeated Zimbabwe by seven wickets in the second match of the Tri-Series also involving hosts Namibia in Windhoek on Saturday.
South Africa have a depleted squad for the series, having rested most of their regulars, but bounced back from defeat to Namibia on Friday to chase down their victory target with 38 balls remaining.
Zimbabwe posted 144 for eight in their 20 overs, but South Africa replied with ease as they posted 146 for three.
Zimbabwe made a fast start to their innings, with an opening stand of 45 in 5.1 overs between Brian Bennett (34 from 35 balls) and Ben Curran (24 from 12 balls).
As they did against Namibia on Friday, South Africa’s spinners managed to peg them back though, with Prenelan Subrayen (2-27 in 4 overs) and Bjorn Fortuin (1-25 in 4 overs) bowling with control through the middle of the innings.
Lanky fast bowler Duan Jansen, twin brother of South Africa all-rounder Marco Jansen, was expensive in his second international, but returned figures of 3-45 in his 4 overs.
Namibia host Zimbabwe in the third match in the Tri-Series at the same venue on Monday.

items.title: Franco Fontana, Italian master of colour photography, dies at 92
items.author: Alvise Armellini
items.creator: Alvise Armellini
items.summary: Franco Fontana, an Italian photographer famous for turning landscapes into abstract images through the masterful use of colour, geometry and shadows, has died at the age of 92, Italian media reported on Saturday.
items.body:
Franco Fontana, an Italian photographer famous for turning landscapes into abstract images through the masterful use of colour, geometry and shadows, has died at the age of 92, Italian media reported on Saturday.
Starting his career in the 1960s, when black and white still dominated fine art photography, Fontana was a pioneer of colour, influenced by abstract expressionism and minimalism.
Some of his best-known pictures — showing southern Italian beaches or countryside in stark, bright colours, sometimes featuring a single tree, cloud or human shadow — evoked the work of abstract painter Mark Rothko.
"I believe that (photography) should not document reality, but interpret it," he said in a statement for his 2014 "Full Color" exhibition.
"Reality is a bit like a block of marble. You can use it to make an ashtray, or Michelangelo's 'Pieta'," he added, referring to the sculpture in St Peter's Basilica.
Fontana was also celebrated for his urban landscapes, both in Italy and the United States, which typically played with stark lines, shadows, and details of parked cars, and for his nude photography.
Born in Modena, northern Italy, on December 9, 1933, Fontana never left his hometown, turning down an offer to move to New York while working for Vogue America.
A school dropout, he developed an interest in photography during military service and started experimenting with it, first as an amateur, in the early 1960s.
In the following decades, he had more than 400 personal exhibitions, worked in fashion and advertising, and had his work displayed in more than 50 museums around the world.
In Rome, he was celebrated with a major retrospective, featuring more than 200 photographs, that ran from December 2024 to August 2025.

items.title: Angels' resiliency to be put to test in rematch vs. Phillies
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: Despite seeing his team lose an American League-high 83 games, Los Angeles Angels manager Kurt Suzuki has gone out of his way to praise his club's resiliency.
items.body:
Despite seeing his team lose an American League-high 83 games, Los Angeles Angels manager Kurt Suzuki has gone out of his way to praise his club's resiliency.
"They never give up," Suzuki said after the Angels lost their fifth straight game in true gut-punch fashion. Los Angeles dropped a 5-3 decision to the Philadelphia Phillies on Friday night in the opener of a three-game series in Anaheim, Calif.
Pinch-hitter Edmundo Sosa hit a grand slam with two outs in the top of the ninth to help rally the Phillies to victory. Sosa's first career grand slam came one batter after Los Angeles outfielder Wade Meckler made a highlight-reel catch to rob Bryson Stott of a go-ahead three-run homer.
Angels closer Ben Joyce walked J.T. Realmuto to load the bases before giving way to Sammy Peralta. Sosa deposited a 1-1 changeup over the fence in left-center field for Philadelphia's first go-ahead grand slam with two outs in the ninth inning of a game since Shane Victorino in 2009.
Los Angeles also surrendered a late lead in a 4-3 setback to the Cleveland Guardians on Wednesday.
"It's part of the game," Meckler told the Orange County Register after Friday night's latest meltdown. "Baseball is tough. Everybody is good and it's part of the game."
The Angels will put Suzuki's resiliency theory to the test on Saturday when they try to rebound against Philadelphia left-hander Cristopher Sanchez.
Sanchez (16-4, 2.62 ERA), one of the candidates for the National League Cy Young Award, is tied for the major league lead in victories. He hasn't lost a game since July 6 at Kansas City.
Sanchez, who is 0-0 with a 5.73 ERA in three career appearances (two starts) against Los Angeles, also is closing in on a couple of impressive milestones. He needs six more strikeouts to reach 200 for the second straight season, and he needs four more wins to become the Phillies' first 20-game winner since Hall of Famer Roy Halladay in 2010.
"It would be an honor to be in a position to get to 20 wins," Sanchez recently told MLB.com. "But my first goal is always to throw as many quality innings as I can for the team and always leave the team in good position to win games whenever I'm out there on the mound."
Friday's comeback win moved Philadelphia three games ahead of the San Diego Padres for the second NL wild-card spot and 3 1/2 games in front of Arizona for the final wild-card spot.
Rookie right-hander Ryan Johnson (3-7, 5.75) will make his first career start against Philadelphia.
Johnson carried a no-hit bid into the sixth inning in his most recent start at Texas last Saturday before allowing a leadoff single to Cody Freeman. He left after throwing a career-high seven innings, allowing just the one hit and no runs in a 3-0 victory.
"He's been trending up," Suzuki said of Johnson. "Stuff's getting better. He's getting more consistent. He believes in himself. ... When you throw with confidence, you tend to keep getting better and better."
Johnson has a 1.69 ERA in his last four starts.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Unrelenting Djokovic refuses to give up on record major dream as US Open begins
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: The 146th edition of the U.S. Open kicks off on Sunday, with former finalist and local favorite Jessica Pegula launching her bid to win her maiden Grand Slam, while Novak Djokovic continues his quest for a record 25th major.
items.body:
The 146th edition of the U.S. Open kicks off on Sunday, with former finalist and local favorite Jessica Pegula launching her bid to win her maiden Grand Slam, while Novak Djokovic continues his quest for a record 25th major.
Two-time winner Venus Williams will make her 26th appearance in the main draw, while Marta Kostyuk, who reached the semi-finals in the last two majors, looks to carry that momentum into the last Grand Slam of the year.
TOP MEN'S MATCH: NOVAK DJOKOVIC V MARIANO NAVONE Since winning the U.S. Open in 2023, Djokovic has reached two Grand Slam finals and six semi-finals, but a 25th major trophy, which would take him past Margaret Court to become the single most successful player in tennis history, has remained just beyond his reach.
But the 39-year-old, ranked fifth in the world, remains defiant in his pursuit, shrugging off the idea of retiring any time soon in a documentary about his life released earlier this month.
“I know a lot of people are retiring me already, for many years,” he said in the documentary "Novak Djokovic: the Wolf in Winter".
“Why would you want me to retire when I am still playing and competing at the highest level? I’m still top-five, top-10 in the world. Why would I talk about retirement when I am proving to myself that I can still win?”
Last year, Djokovic lost in the semi-finals of all four Grand Slams. He reached the Australian Open final this year, before reaching the last four at Wimbledon.
"I guess for 99% of the players, that would be a very good Grand Slam result. For me, it's good but not good enough, because I'm blessed and cursed to be used to something of a highest degree in terms of results and achievements," Djokovic said after his Wimbledon loss in July.
TOP WOMEN'S MATCH: JESSICA PEGULA V ELENA-GABRIELA RUSE The closest Pegula has got to a Grand Slam title was on home soil, where she went down fighting to Aryna Sabalenka in the 2024 U.S. Open final. Last year, Sabalenka knocked her out again, this time in the semis.
“I always feel like I'm close. I always feel I can go out, and I can beat these girls," Pegula said after last year's U.S. Open exit.
"Even though maybe I don't have the massive weapon that some of them have, or the flashiness that some of them have, I feel like I'm always right there every time I play them."
This year, Pegula has reached the semi-finals of the Australian Open, and the quarters at Wimbledon. She also reached the finals of the Washington Open and Cincinnati Open in the lead-up to the U.S. Open.
But the 32-year-old is not keen to dwell on defeats.
"You just kind of have to wipe it and move on and move forward and keep working on some stuff that I want to get better," she said ahead of her 10th main draw appearance at Flushing Meadows.
KOSTYUK LOOKS TO BUILD ON STRONG SEASON Kostyuk made her Grand Slam main draw debut in 2018, but it took her a few years to establish herself on the circuit.
She had turned heads with a run to the Australian Open quarter-finals in 2024, but the 24-year-old has finally hit her stride this year, reaching the semis of the French Open and Wimbledon.
She holds a career-best ranking of 11th in the world going into the U.S. Open, and has the opportunity to scale greater heights as she kicks off her campaign at the Grandstand against Australia's Storm Hunter.
“I want to cherish this moment. I want to appreciate how far we've all come, me and my team,” Ukraine's Kostyuk said after her Wimbledon exit following a loss to champion Linda Noskova last month.
"You don’t know how your life is going to look tomorrow, today, whenever. Hopefully, I will get more opportunities, but you never know if you will."
